description: Download one published package and run static analysis on its code with MoorAI's open-source engine. npm and PyPI packages also get ten MCP pre-install checks on their registry metadata, a reputation score and a known-compromised release check. Static analysis only: the package is never installed and the server is never run. Returns a verdict (CLEAN, CAUTION, REVIEW, DO-NOT-INSTALL or NAME-NOT-PUBLISHED), content-free findings (threat ids, categories, file paths, hashes; never file contents) and a permalink. The package name and version are sent to its registry. A completed analysis is reused for 24 hours; a new one can take a minute and runs one at a time.

ref.description: npm:<name>[@version], pypi:<name>[==version] or github:<owner>/<repo>/<path>[@ref] (a folder, not a whole repository)

name: scan_package
title: Scan an MCP server or skill package
